text:
Maria Chen: quick handoff — I'm taking off, leaving notes for the midnight->morning shift. TL;DR: one active incident (embed-ingest backpressure in eu-west1), degraded regen latency on a Dedicated pool (gpu-slab-3), canary for kernel-optim v2 paused. full checks below.

Owen Patel: acked. where's the alert link?

oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-8732 created — embed-ingest queue depth high (eu-west1). Pager duty: eng-oncall.

Maria Chen: alert: https://monitoring.internal/incidents/INC-8732 — top-line: queue depth 27, avg processing time 4.2s (normally ~0.9s). spike started ~00:12 UTC.

Kevin Li: did an initial scale: bumped regen-workers eu-west1 from 6 -> 12, restarted the ingestion consumer on pod regen-ingest-7f9b. reduced waiters but still a few long tails. snippet from logs: `2026-03-18T00:23:45Z regen-ingest ERROR processing item id=... timeout after 30s`

Sanjay Rao: looks like a noisy neighbor on the dedicated pool — `nvidia-smi` showed one pod hogging 98% GPU mem. I evicted pod gpu-bench-3 and set node.affinity to avoid bench nodes.

Owen Patel: thanks — did we pause canary? at 00:05 we saw increased latency on canary requests too.

Maria Chen: yes paused the canary, rolled traffic back to stable v1-kernel via routing policy. Canary metrics: p50 up from 120ms -> 380ms, p95 from 600ms -> 1.6s.

Kevin Li: ingestion throttles applied: rate limit 50r/s on the ingest API (rule id rl-eu-031). Also enabled prefix KV cache fallback for frequently-requested prefixes to reduce regen pressure.

Sanjay Rao: autoscaler note — HPA for regen-workers has a min replica 6 but metric collector had intermittent gaps; I pushed a patch to add external metric smoothing: PR #4821. It should prevent oscillation.

Owen Patel: next steps from me: watch queue depth and p95 for 30m, if queue > 40 or p95 > 2s escalate to infra-sre and follow incident playbook. Will also keep an eye on preemptions in eu-west1.

Maria Chen: morning handoff for you @Owen — checklist: 1) confirm queue drains under 15 within 30m; 2) verify canary remains paused until p95 < 800ms for 30m; 3) if noisy node recurs, cordon and file infra ticket with node id; 4) follow up on PR #4821.

Owen Patel: got it. ping me if anything spikes.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot posted: Canary rollout paused by Maria Chen for v2-kernel at 00:18 UTC.

Maria Chen: final: left a short runbook in the incident doc (see link above) with commands: `kubectl -n regen describe hpa regen-workers`, `kc logs -f deploy/regen-ingest -c consumer`, `redis-cli -h kvcache-eu info memory`. DM me for context. logging off. :wave:

Kevin Li: cheers, thanks for the handoff.

Sanjay Rao: 👍  will monitor infra for next 2 hrs and update if anything else shows up.
